question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

WITH player_match_stats AS (
    -- Calculate total runs and matches for each player
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.country_name,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bb.match_id) AS total_matches
    FROM ipl.main.player p
    JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball bb ON p.player_id = bb.striker
    JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE p.country_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.country_name
),
player_averages AS (
    -- Calculate average runs per match for each player
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        country_name,
        total_runs / NULLIF(total_matches, 0) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_stats
    WHERE total_matches > 0
),
country_averages AS (
    -- Calculate average of player averages for each country
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        AVG(avg_runs_per_match) AS country_avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_averages
    GROUP BY country_name
)
-- Get top 5 countries by average runs per match
SELECT 
    country_name,
    country_avg_runs_per_match
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country_avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
